segments.ja185:1.1: Yathodake āvile appasanne, na passati sippikasambukañca;
segments.ja185:1.3: Sakkharaṃ vālukaṃ macchagumbaṃ, evaṃ āvilamhi [āvile hi (sī.)] citte;
segments.ja185:2.1: Yathodake acche vippasanne, so passati sippikasambukañca;
segments.ja185:2.3: Sakkharaṃ vālukaṃ macchagumbaṃ, evaṃ anāvilamhi citte;

lines: Attadatthaṃ paratthanti neva attadatthaṃ na paratthaṃ passatīti attho.
So passatīti evameva anāvile citte so puriso attadatthaṃ paratthañca passatīti.
